boundaries: These are pure unit/contract tests; they do not claim Medusa, PostgreSQL, browser, worker recovery, or live LLM integration.

challengedHypothesis: A caller-supplied requiredPermissions list is not a safe authorization ceiling. Capability permissions must be derived again from the trusted manifest; the mutation-red test proved a requester would otherwise gain a write capability.
